educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire basic knowledge necessary for teaching mathematics in secondary education, and aim to acquire skills for making and doing a math lesson.
advice: In order to acquire skill for a math lesson, we will cover the following materials. 1. The analysis of textbooks in secondary education 2. How to make a lesson plan for mathematics in secondary education 3. Each of students will make lesson practices, and discuss about them. The above learning activities will help the students acquire skills for making and doing a math lesson. The students need efforts outside class hours. We expect the students to consider deeply about an effective math lesson.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand textbooks in “Mathematics” and make plans how to use them effectively. (2) Create teaching plans and materials which take into account students' actual conditions. (3) Be aware of good points of your lesson-making and have your own opinion about an effective lesson of mathematics. (4) Understand improvements of a lesson you made, and modify your lesson plan for good, mathematical education.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事
